column1: Information theory lies at the heart of everything – from DVD players and the genetic code of DNA to the physics of the universe at its most fundamental.
column2: 信息论贯穿一切——从DVD播放器、DNA的遗传密码，到宇宙最基本的物理规律，无一不体现其核心地位。

column1: It has been central to the development of the science of communication, which enables data to be sent electronically and has therefore had a major impact on our lives
column2: 信息论在通信科学的发展中起到了核心作用，因为它使数据能够通过电子方式传输，从而深刻地改变了我们的生活。

column1: In April 2002 an event took place which demonstrated one of the many applications of information theory.
column2: 2002年4月发生的一件事，展示了信息论众多用途中的一种。

column1: The space probe, Voyager I, launched in 1977, had sent back spectacular images of Jupiter and Saturn and then soared out of the Solar System on a one-way mission to the stars.
column2: ‘旅行者1号’太空探测器于1977年发射升空，传回了木星和土星令人惊叹的图像，之后便以单程任务的方式飞出了太阳系，前往恒星领域。

column1: After 25 years of exposure to the freezing temperatures of deep space, the probe was beginning to show its age.
column2: 在经历了25年之久的深空冷冻环境后，这艘探测器开始显现出老化的迹象。

column1: Sensors and circuits were on the brink of failing and NASA experts realised that they had to do something or lose contact with their probe forever.
column2: 这些传感器和电路已经濒临失效的边缘，NASA的专家们意识到，他们必须立即采取行动，否则就会永远失去与探测器的联系。

column1: The solution was to get a message to Voyager I to instruct it to use spares to change the failing parts.
column2: 解决方案是向‘旅行者1号’卫星发送消息，指示其使用备用部件来更换那些出现故障的部件。

column1: With the probe 12 billion kilometres from Earth, this was not an easy task.
column2: 由于探测器距离地球有120亿公里远，因此这项任务并不容易完成。

column1: By means of a radio dish belonging to NASA’s Deep Space Network, the message was sent out into the depths of space.
column2: 通过NASA深空网络中的无线电发射装置，这条消息被传送到宇宙的深处。

column1: Even travelling at the speed of light, it took over 11 hours to reach its target, far beyond the orbit of Pluto.
column2: 即使以光速行驶，也需要超过11小时才能抵达目标，而该目标远在冥王星轨道之外。

column1: Yet, incredibly, the little probe managed to hear the faint call from its home planet, and successfully made the switchover.
column2: 然而，令人惊讶的是，这个小型探测器竟然成功收到了来自母星的微弱信号，并顺利完成了切换过程。

column1: It was the longest-distance repair job in history, and a triumph for the NASA engineers.
column2: 这是历史上最长距离的维修任务，也是NASA工程师们的巨大胜利。

column1: But it also highlighted the astonishing power of the techniques developed by American communications engineer Claude Shannon, who had died just a year earlier.
column2: 但这件事也凸显了美国通信工程师克劳德·香农所开发的技术具有何等惊人的力量。就在一年前，香农去世了。
column10: just a year earlier|就在一年前

column1: Born in 1916 in Petoskey, Michigan, Shannon showed an early talent for maths and for building gadgets, and made breakthroughs in the foundations of computer technology when still a student.
column2: 香农出生于1916年，出生地是密歇根州的佩托斯基。他从小就展现出对数学和发明创造的热爱。在还是学生的时候，就取得了在计算机技术领域的重大突破。

column1: While at Bell Laboratories, Shannon developed information theory, but shunned the resulting acclaim.
column2: 在贝尔实验室工作期间，香农发展了信息理论，却回避了由此带来的赞誉。

column1: In the 1940s, he single-handedly created an entire science of communication which has since inveigled its way into a host of applications, from DVDs to satellite communications to bar codes - any area, in short, where data has to be conveyed rapidly yet accurately.
column2: 20世纪40年代，他独力创立了一整门通信科学。从那以后，这门科学逐渐渗透到众多应用之中，从DVD到卫星通信，再到条形码。简而言之，凡是需要迅速而又准确地传递数据的领域，都用得上它。
column8: inveigled its way into|逐渐渗透到

column1: This all seems light years away from the down-to-earth uses Shannon originally had for his work, which began when he was a 22-year-old graduate engineering student at the prestigious Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1939.
column2: 这一切似乎与香农最初为这项研究设想的实际用途相去甚远。这项研究始于1939年，当时22岁的香农是著名的麻省理工学院的一名工程学研究生。
column3: light years away from|与……相去甚远
column9: graduate engineering student|工程学研究生
column11: Massachusetts Institute of Technology|n. 麻省理工学院

column1: He set out with an apparently simple aim: to pin down the precise meaning of the concept of ‘information’.
column2: 他出发时的目标似乎很简单：就是明确‘信息’这一概念的确切含义。

column1: The most basic form of information, Shannon argued, is whether something is true or false - which can be captured in the binary unit, or ‘bit’, of the form 1 or 0.
column2: 香农认为，信息最基本的形态是真与假的判断——这一信息可以被表示为二进制单位‘比特’，即1或0。

column1: Having identified this fundamental unit, Shannon set about defining otherwise vague ideas about information and how to transmit it from place to place.
column2: 在确定了这一基本单位之后，香农开始对信息及其如何从一处传输到另一处的概念进行明确界定。

column1: In the process he discovered something surprising: it is always possible to guarantee information will get through random interference – ‘noise’, - intact.
column2: 在此过程中，他发现了一个令人惊讶的事实：无论存在何种随机干扰——即‘噪声’——信息都能完整地传递。

column1: Noise usually means unwanted sounds which interfere with genuine information.
column2: 噪音通常指的是那些干扰真实信息、不必要的声音。

column1: Information theory generalises this idea via theorems that capture the effects of noise with mathematical precision.
column2: 信息论通过定理以数学的精确度捕捉噪音的影响。

column1: In particular, Shannon showed that noise sets a limit on the rate at which information can pass along communication channels while remaining error-free.
column2: 特别是，香农证明了噪声会限制信息在通信信道中传输的速度，同时还能确保传输过程无错误。

column1: This rate depends on the relative strengths of the signal and noise travelling down the communication channel, and on its capacity (its ‘bandwidth’).
column2: 这个速率取决于信号与噪声在通信通道中的相对强度及其容量（即带宽）

column1: The resulting limit, given in units of bits per second, is the absolute maximum rate of error-free communication given signal strength and noise level.
column2: 由此得出的极限以比特每秒为单位。在信号强度和噪声水平给定的条件下，它就是无差错通信所能达到的最高速率。
column7: absolute maximum rate|所能达到的最高速率

column1: The trick, Shannon showed, is to find ways of packaging up – ‘coding’, - information to cope with the ravages of noise, while staying within the information-carrying capacity -’bandwidth’ - of the communication system being used.
column2: 香农指出，诀窍在于想办法把信息打包，即对信息进行编码，以应对噪声的破坏。同时，信息量要控制在所用通信系统的信息承载能力之内，也就是不能超过它的带宽。

column1: Over the years scientists have devised many such coding methods, and they have proved crucial in many technological feats.
column2: 多年来，科学家们设计了许多这样的编码方法。这些方法在许多技术壮举中都起到了关键作用。

column1: The Voyager spacecraft transmitted data using codes which added one extra bit for every single bit of information; the result was an error rate of just one bit in 10,000 - and stunningly clear pictures of the planets.
column2: 旅行者号航天器用编码传输数据，每传输一比特信息，就额外加上一比特。结果，每一万比特中仅有一比特出错，传回的行星图像也清晰得惊人。

column1: Other codes have become part of everyday life - such as the Universal Product Code, or bar code, which uses a simple error-detecting system that ensures supermarket check-out lasers can read the price even on, say, a crumpled bag of crisps.
column2: 另一些编码已成为日常生活的一部分，例如通用产品代码，也称条形码。它采用简单的检错系统，即使是一袋包装皱巴巴的薯片，超市收银台的激光扫描器也能读出价格。
column5: Universal Product Code|通用产品代码
column9: check-out lasers|收银台的激光扫描器

column1: As recently as 1993, engineers made a major breakthrough by discovering so-called turbo codes - which come very close to Shannon’s ultimate limit for the maximum rate that data can be transmitted reliably, and now play a key role in the mobile videophone revolution.
column2: 就在1993年，工程师们发现了所谓的涡轮码，取得了一项重大突破。使用这种编码时，数据可靠传输的速率非常接近香农所确定的理论上限。如今，这种编码在移动视频通话技术的革新中发挥着关键作用。
column9: come very close to|非常接近
column14: play a key role in|在……中发挥关键作用

column1: Shannon also laid the foundations of more efficient ways of storing information, by stripping out superfluous (‘redundant’) bits from data which contributed little real information.
column2: 香农还为更高效的信息存储方法奠定了基础。他的做法是从数据中剔除多余的（即“冗余的”）比特，因为这些比特几乎没有提供什么实际信息。
column3: laid the foundations of|为……奠定基础

column1: As mobile phone text messages like ‘I CN C U’ show, it is often possible to leave out a lot of data without losing much meaning.
column2: 正如用“I CN C U”来表示“我能看见你”这样的手机短信所示，省去大量数据，往往也不会损失多少含义。

column1: As with error correction, however, there’s a limit beyond which messages become too ambiguous.
column2: 不过，和纠错一样，信息压缩也有个限度。一旦超过这个限度，信息的含义就会过于模糊。

column1: Shannon showed how to calculate this limit, opening the way to the design of compression methods that cram maximum information into the minimum space.
column2: 香农说明了如何计算这个极限，为设计出能用最小空间容纳最多信息的压缩方法铺平了道路。
column5: opening the way to|为……铺平道路
